name: screen.capture
description: Pixel capture of region, window, monitor, or virtual screen. If neither region nor window nor monitor is supplied, the entire virtual screen is captured. Returned bytes are base64-encoded image data in the requested format.

window.description: Window handle, e.g. 'win:0x1A2B' on Windows or 'mac:42' on macOS.

monitor.description: Zero-based monitor index as reported by system.info.screens.

format.description: Output image format. Family-dependent — see x-families. Requesting an unsupported format returns ERR unsupported_format.

windows-modern.description: WGC fast path on Win 10 1803+; GDI BitBlt fallback for Vista-8.1 if WGC is unavailable. PNG/WebP/BMP via WIC. Multi-monitor full.

windows-classic.description: GDI BitBlt only. PNG only if GDI+ runtime present (NT 4 SP6+ with redist; XP+ ships GDI+). Multi-monitor: NT 4 single-display, 2000+ multi.
